title: Nutrient-Response Kinetics Across System States and Tissues
scientific_scope: All frozen baseline phenotypes, circulating-input measurements, nutrient-response time courses, and tissue-uptake measurements.
analysis_unit: One biological replicate within a system state, tissue, input condition, or time course; repeated measures sharing a state are nested.
missingness: No curator-imposed row deletion, random subsampling, or imputation is applied within the frozen task boundary.
license_boundary: The selected source-data workbook is CC BY and is bundled with tissue and system identities represented by neutral identifiers.
warnings: Cross-panel association does not uniquely establish molecular causality.
System-state and tissue groups must be held out intact when testing generalization.
source_coverage_statement: The bundled files are complete within the scientific_scope declared for this task. This does not assert that every variable, record, or file in the upstream scientific source is included.
